messages:
Ivy: Quick check-in  we need a tight launch pack for the three landing flows (Hosted / Dedicated / Private). Main asks: hero variants, one-line proofs, webinar CTA, and exact form field slugs for routing. Can we close by EOD?
Samir: Ill take hero variants + microcopy for Hosted. Thinking three hooks: performance-led, developer-led, cost-led. Each with a one-line proof + CTA.
Nora: Ill own Dedicated and Private micro bullets + the tiny benchmark callout for Dedicated (label as "sample results"). Also will draft the short FAQ line for Dedicated scaling.
Felipe: Ill produce three short launch posts (X/Twitter, LinkedIn, product blog blurb) and the webinar registration language. Also will propose UTM naming.
Ivy: For routing, prefer snake_case slugs: `deployment_choice`, `lead_intent`, `company_tier`. Lead intents: demo, enterprise, technical, webinar. Routing fanout: demo/enterprise -> sales; technical -> devx; webinar -> growth. Do we want immediate slack pings for demo only?
Samir: Hosted hero ideas (very short): A) "Hosted inference, ship faster." proof: "p50 ~100ms (sample)." CTA: "Get started (free credits)". B) "API-first access to production LLMs." proof: "SDKs + curated models." CTA: "View docs". C) "Lower cost per request with caching" proof: "Auto-prefix cache, example workloads." CTA alt: "See optimizations"
Nora: Dedicated micro bullets (3-5 words each): "Reserved GPU pools", "Throughput SLAs", "Burst capacity", "Enterprise support SLA". Benchmark blurb: "Sample results: ~180 QPS, p95 220ms on standard config (see benchmarks)." Private micro bullets: "VPC & on-prem", "KMS/HSM integrations", "Audit logs & SOC2-ready". FAQ line: "Yes  Dedicated customers can set pinning and rollout windows."
Felipe: Webinar short pitch: subject: "How to run LLMs at production economics" body: 2 bullets (what we'll demo + what you'll learn) + CTA to RSVP. RSVP fields I propose: `company_name`, `company_tier (startup|mid|enterprise)`, `deployment_choice (hosted|dedicated|private)`, `lead_intent (demo|enterprise|technical|webinar)`, `email` + opt-in. UTM: source=launch_pack, medium=social, campaign=prod-econ-mar
Ivy: Good. Routing matrix (copy this into ops):```\ndeployment_choice -> Hosted|Dedicated|Private\nlead_intent -> demo|enterprise|technical|webinar\ncompany_tier -> startup|mid|enterprise\nif lead_intent == demo -> route: sales-demo-queue + slack_alert:#sales-notifs immediate\nif lead_intent == enterprise -> route: sales-enterprise-queue + add_tag:enterprise_ops\nif lead_intent == technical -> route: devx-ticket-queue (batch daily)\nif lead_intent == webinar -> route: growth-rsvp-automation\nif deployment_choice == Private and lead_intent in [demo, enterprise] -> add_tag:private_priority\n```
Felipe: Will include those slugs in the RSVP form. Also planning follow-up cadence: day0: confirmation + calendar + 2-min preview; day2: highlight reel + checklist; day7: Sales outreach (if qualified).
Samir: One more copy nuance: on Hosted hero performance claim, include a short parenthetical sample workload so it reads concrete: e.g., "p50 ~100ms (short Q&A prompts, sample)."
Nora: Note on benchmarks: ensure language uses "sample results" and links out. Avoid absolute guarantees.
growth-bot: Test payload sent to staging: {"company_name":"Acme","lead_intent":"demo","deployment_choice":"Hosted","company_tier":"mid"} -> queued (job 21077) :white_check_mark:
Ivy: Action items:
- Samir: finalize 3 hero variants + CTAs for Hosted (due 3pm)
- Nora: finalize Dedicated/Private bullets + benchmark snippet (due 3pm)
- Felipe: publish 3 social post drafts + webinar RSVP copy + UTM table (due 4pm)
- Ops: implement routing matrix with `deployment_choice`, `lead_intent`, `company_tier` slugs and enable immediate slack pings for demo only (due 5pm)
Felipe: Ill schedule posts pending final copy.
Samir: Uploading copy doc now, will paste link when ready.
Nora: Will push final bullets to /marketing-assets and tag #design for small banners.
Ivy: Thanks all  once items are complete Ill assemble the launch bundle and queue the publish. React with :rocket: when done.
